Package com.neueda.leap.user

package com.neueda.leap.user
Authentication and current-user domain.

This package contains user-facing auth controllers, DTOs, persistence types, and domain-specific exceptions. Service behavior is exposed via UserService and implemented by UserServiceImpl.
